entries.1015e15d12b2ffe7: Others (applied equipment, synthetic quartz, quartz blanks, etc.)
entries.10373829bd4f21f8: These are applied equipment and materials such as synthetic quartz and quartz blanks. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥6,021 million; while sales for specialized equipment, mainly for defense, increased, optical products decreased.
entries.1da129378d9e29e6: Founded in 1948, the company is headquartered in Sasazuka, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo. The group consists of 15 companies in total: the company, two domestic subsidiaries, two domestic affiliates and ten overseas subsidiaries, and consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 2,313.
entries.27b32999ed8bae28: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥54,629 million, up 2.9% from the previous year. Crystal resonators accounted for ¥39,513 million, crystal oscillators for ¥9,094 million, and other products for ¥6,021 million.
entries.331a13167789cd04: This component combines a crystal resonator with an oscillator circuit to output a signal at a stable frequency.
entries.389ec1f100ae295b: This is a core component that generates the reference frequency for electronic circuits.
entries.498edeb18583899e: The model covers everything from growing synthetic quartz crystal to manufacturing quartz crystal resonators and quartz crystal oscillators in an integrated process, with manufacturing and sales shared among a network of domestic and overseas subsidiaries, supplying quartz devices to equipment makers in automotive, communications, industrial equipment and other fields.
entries.4b73a318781dc7bd: Net profit for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,065 million, up 15.2% from the previous year. Advance investment in R&D, DX and cutting-edge equipment was a factor that temporarily pulled down profit for the period.
entries.65c19ebf98a85e9b: This business integrates the manufacture and sale of crystal-related products, including crystal resonators, crystal oscillators, other crystal devices, applied equipment, synthetic quartz and quartz blanks. There are no business segments requiring separation, so there is a single reportable segment; in addition to the company's own manufacturing and sales, manufacturing is outsourced to consolidated subsidiaries in Japan and overseas.
entries.7ed11a3ea9e182e0: Customers in automotive, communications and industrial equipment, among others
entries.8ebb7c2c26e4025c: The company grows artificial quartz crystal in-house as its material and manufactures quartz devices such as crystal resonators and crystal oscillators. It also outsources manufacturing to its domestic subsidiaries in Furukawa and Hakodate and to its overseas subsidiaries in Malaysia and China.
entries.98102f2298b0f5b1: An electronic components manufacturer that handles crystal devices such as quartz crystal units and crystal oscillators in an integrated manner, starting from the production of synthetic quartz.
entries.b67dcebe4752637c: In working toward Vision2030, the company is pursuing the portfolio transformation “Five Pillars + One” set out in its medium-term management plan. With the aim of dramatically improving productivity, the company is working on upgrading to cutting-edge production lines and introducing DX, and is making upfront investments in R&D, DX and cutting-edge equipment.
entries.b7d3e9e40f1cb878: This is a core component that generates the reference frequency for electronic circuits. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥39,513 million; while sales for automotive applications increased, sales for mobile communications, including smartphones, decreased.
